content: अनन्य {%a.%} .²1 Not different, identical, same, not other than, self; अनन्या राघवस्याहं भास्करस्य प्रभा यथा . सा हि सत्याभिसन्धाना तथानन्या च भर्तरि <ls>Rām.</ls> <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Rām. 5. 21. 15</ls>. .²2 Sole, unique, without a second. .²3 [नास्ति अन्यः विषयो यस्य] Undivided, undistracted (mind <ab>&c.</ab>); having no other object or person to think of <ab>&c.</ab>; अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते <ls>Bg. 9. 22</ls>. In <ab>comp.</ab> अनन्य may be translated by ‘not by another’, ‘directed or devoted to no one else’, ‘having no other object’. .²4 unopposed; अनन्यां पृथिवीं भुङ्क्ते सर्वभूतहिते रतः <ls>Kau. A.</ls>
